research_questions: Does a training-fold-only physics prior improve fuel prediction under aircraft and route shift?
Do physics-residual Mondrian intervals retain coverage with less width than standard split conformal and CQR?
Does exact or robust risk-budget selection improve utility at matched empirical risk and coverage relative to established selectors?

hypotheses.H1: PI-MCS coverage is at least 1-alpha-tolerance on aircraft-held-out data where standard split conformal under-covers.
hypotheses.H2: PI-MCS intervals are narrower than standard conformal and CQR at matched coverage.
hypotheses.H3: Exact optimization has greater utility than greedy selection at the same risk budget and minimum coverage, with its solver gap reported.
hypotheses.H4: The physics prior improves held-out-aircraft error relative to the same residual learner without physics.

multiplicity: Holm for confirmatory hypotheses; BH for explicitly exploratory families
claim_rule: Every hypothesis is PASS, FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE. No result is emitted unless source hashes, split audit and leakage checks pass.
